CPE Reading and Use of English practice

C2 Proficiency practice

Reading and Use of English, Parts 1 to 4

  • Part 1, Multiple-choice cloze: 8 questions
  • Part 2, Open cloze: 8 questions
  • Part 3, Word formation: 8 questions
  • Part 4, Key word transformation: 6 questions

Do the parts in any order and move between them whenever you like. Press Submit in a part to see your score, the correct answers and an explanation for each one. Use Try again to redo a part. Submit all four parts to earn experience points (XP) that you can spend on stickers.
